children: Joachim Nagel is all but out of the running to succeed Christine Lagarde at the helm of the European Central Bank, as it is highly unlikely that the German government will nominate the Bundesbank head for the role, business daily Handelsblatt reported on Friday, citing four people familiar with the process.
